neighbours.label: a heading or marker that sets up an explanation, on its last token: 'Why X?' before the reasons, 'Your brain:' before the benefit, as opposed to headings with facts and plain questions
fire:
Why Protect Wetlands?
They filter our water.

Why Use Humor in Class?
It keeps students awake.
Keep your sentences short. WHY? Readers lose focus quickly.

Benefits of sleep for your body
- Your heart: rest lowers blood pressure.

Why Learn Latin?
It trains the memory.

Reasons to walk daily
- Your mood: fresh air helps.

Why Do Cats Purr?
Mostly they feel safe.
Eat slowly. WHY? The stomach needs time to signal.
